title: Shower Door Hardware Single-Side Pull 8-Inch Solid Brass Clearview Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your shower door hardware with an 8-Inch single-side pull crafted from solid brass and accented with clear acrylic for a clean, modern-ready look.

  • Coordinated design: Part of the Clearview collection to help match other versatile bath accessories.
  • Solid brass construction: Built for dependable everyday use.
  • Clear acrylic accents: Adds a crisp detail that suits transitional bathroom hardware schemes.
  • Clean installation look: Concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Ready to install: Includes the shower door pull and all installation hardware; no assembly required.

Specs

  • Category: Shower door hardware (shower door pull)
  • Mounting type: Shower door mount
  • Dimensions: 9 in (L) x 1.7 in (W) x 3.9 in (H)
  • Weight: 3.2 lb
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Clearview Collection 8 Inch Single Side Shower Door Pull
_previous.description: The clean sharp lines of this modern shower door pull fits well with any bathroom décor ranging from modern to traditional. Made from high quality solid brass with accents of clear acrylic and provided with your choice of any of our lifetime designer finishes, the shower door pull is extremely attractive yet highly functional. Ideal for glass shower doors of all sizes and styles, the easy to install shower door pull comes with durable u-shaped pull made from solid brass and all the hardware necessary for installation.
